description: This file defines a custom authentication state provider for Blazor applications, named 'CustomAuthStateProvider'. It manages user authentication state by fetching user info from a web API, caching it, and updating claims as necessary.

classes.name: CustomAuthStateProvider
classes.description: A custom implementation of AuthenticationStateProvider that fetches user information from a web API and manages authentication state with caching.

methods.name: GetAuthenticationStateAsync
methods.description: Overrides the base method to provide the current authentication state, using cached user info if available.

methods.name: GetUser
methods.description: Retrieves the user claims principal, using cache if specified and valid.

methods.name: FetchUser
methods.description: Fetches user info from the web API, constructs ClaimsPrincipal with claims, and updates HTTP headers with the user's token.
